name: Acquirer To Acceptor Batch File Exchange V 03
definition: The AcquirerToAcceptorBatchFileExchange message is sent by an acquirer (or its agent) to the acceptor (or its agent), to send a batch of response.

BodyElement.name: Body Element
BodyElement.definition: Record of an exchange to an Acceptor.

Response.name: Response
Response.definition: Result of the processing of the request.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC or a signature.
